newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar closes weaker in moderate trading.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar closes weaker in moderate trading.

text.p: * Canada's dollar closed weaker at C$1.3627 (US$0.7339) on Friday from Thursday's close at C$1.3585 (US$0.7361) in moderate trading, dealers said.
* They said the Canadian currency market lost the limelight as investors focused on U.S. bond markets, which outperformed Canada's and pushed the U.S. dollar stronger.
Dealers said the threat of intervention by the Bank of Canada restrained the currency from breaking through support at C$1.3650 (US$0.7326).
Volume was moderate for December, but many of the bigger players have finished up their business for the season, said dealers.
The currency was expected to strengthen slightly over the next week, dealers said.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar rose to 1.1402 marks from Thursday's close of 1.1339 marks and edged up to 83.48 yen from 83.28 yen.
